title: GEOquery Improvement Roadmap
text: Layer 1 — Auto-triage issue open (P1, M, .github/workflows/issue-triage.yaml) Trigger issues: [opened, edited, reopened], permissions: {issues: write, contents: read}. One job, two stages: - Deterministic pre-pass (bash/Rscript, source truth): grep body accession regex \b(GSE|GSM|GPL|GDS)[0-9]{1,9}\b (case-insensitive, dedup, cap ~10); keyword→label heuristic (error|traceback|crash|infinite loop→bug; vignette|docs|documentation→docs; |support→question; else enhancement). Apply -accession label list detected accessions comment feed Layer 2. - Claude pass (advisory) via anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 text-mode (shell tools), ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret: produce labels fixed allowlist {bug, enhancement, documentation, question, needs-repro, -accession} plus 3–5 line triage comment. Parse JSON, intersect allowlist applying, prompt-injected body create arbitrary labels. - Security: issue body attacker-controlled — pass via env var / stdin file, never interpolate shell command. Layer 2 — Reproduction harness (P1, L, .github/workflows/repro-harness.yaml) Trigger issues: [labeled] gated needs-repro, plus workflow_dispatch accession+issue_number inputs. Runs container: bioconductor/bioconductor_docker:devel. Reads accession deterministic extractor / dispatch input (never re-parses arbitrary body text), installs package, runs tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(getGEO(acc, GSEMatrix=TRUE), warning=...), error=…) capturing stdout/stderr/warnings/sessionInfo()/packageVersion(). Hard timeout-minutes: 20 R-side withTimeout/req_timeout #58/#147 hangs can’t pin runner. Truncate ~64KB, upload full log artifact, post collapsible PASS/FAIL comment. Re-run weekly open -accession issues detect “fixed upstream / now reproduces” drift. Security: downloads NCBI accessions, runs issue-supplied code, uses GITHUB_TOKEN — safe non-collaborator issues. Layer 3 — Issue→PR dispatch (P1, L, .github/workflows/issue--pr.yaml) Trigger issues: [labeled] : github.event.label.name == 'agent-ready' — human-applied label sole dispatch gate (Layer 1 may suggest comment never apply ). Enforce author_association ∈ {OWNER, MEMBER} (mirror pr-commands.yaml). permissions: {contents: write, pull-requests: write, issues: write}. Runs claude-code-action@v1 agent mode: branch agent/issue-<n>-<slug>, minimal change + targeted test, devtools::document() + R CMD check, open draft PR (“Fixes #n”, labels agent-authored + needs-human-review). Guardrails (workflow + CLAUDE.md): (1) never auto-merge — draft PR, branch protection devel requires R-CMD-check matrix + human approval; (2) restrict editable paths R/ man/ tests/testthat/ NEWS DESCRIPTION — block .github/workflows/** agent rewrite guardrails exfiltrate secrets; (3) require -accession + Layer-2 repro code-path fix; (4) run full R-CMD-check matrix agent PR. Documentation reorganized narrative pkgdown articles — Understanding GEO data formats, RNA-seq quantifications, Single-cell data GEO, GEO downstream analysis — cover (entity types, file formats) downstream workflows links Bioconductor packages. package vignette now concise quick-start indexes ; articles render pkgdown site excluded R CMD check (#156, #191). package DESCRIPTION biocViews now describe GEOquery’s actual scope (microarray, RNA-seq, single-cell; GEO Series Matrix files parsed ExpressionSet default) instead microarray-(#71, #181).

title: GEOquery 2.81.21 (2026-06-13)
text: Supplemental-file URLs now built small url_join() helper instead file.path(), mangled https:// https:/ produced double slashes. Affects getGEOSuppFiles(fetch_files = FALSE) getGEOSeriesFileListing() (#131, #178). GDS2eSet() longer fails GDS NA (empty) value ID_REF column (e.g. GDS3666). values replaced usable feature name instead producing “row names contain missing values” (#21, #177). getGEO() now fails clear message accession private, embargoed, yet public (NCBI returns HTML page) instead mis-parsing , older versions, looping. findFirstEntity() also hardened multi-line edge case error unbounded reads (#58, #176). getGEO(parseCharacteristics = FALSE) now actually skips characteristics parsing. flag accepted top level dropped reaching parseGSEMatrix(); now threaded getAndParseGSEMatrices() parseGEO() (#60, #175). Fixed error parsing GSE matrix files malformed empty lines sample metadata (e.g., GSE425). Sample lines now extracted directly using pattern matching avoid issues irregular file formatting (#162).

title: GEOquery 2.75.0 (2024-10-01)
text: RNAseq data support GEOquery. Now can use RNASeq quantification data prepared NCBI. Basic search GEO database. Now can search datasets GEO database using GEOquery. browseGEO() function open web browser GEO accession.
